name: auto-memory-tact
description: A Tact-native bridge to a local auto-memory-rs index for durable engineering context and resumable checkpoints.

interface.longDescription: Brief each Tact session from a local auto-memory-rs index, capture engineering decisions, and checkpoint long-running work so a later session can resume with repo-backed context.
